title: Cross-System Reconciliation Review
description: Review when project payments and treasury transactions do not reconcile.

steps.title: Review the reconciliation status
steps.guidance: Identify the mismatch type (amount, timing, missing transaction, missing reference) and the expected vs found amounts.
steps.evidence_hint: Reconciliation result: status, expected, found, unmatched items

steps.title: Check project-code references
steps.guidance: Missing references are often clerical: verify whether transactions were booked under a wrong or outdated project code.

steps.title: Verify with the disbursing office
steps.guidance: For missing or amount-mismatched transactions, request confirmation of actual disbursements from the disbursing office records.

steps.title: Record a conclusion with reasons
steps.guidance: Route clerical errors as data corrections; unexplained missing funds flow must be escalated with the documented gap.
